Ngo-lung-ku go-gong-ku su-de u-la-on-ku di ho ma Tu-han, se-rep ma ro-hang-ku bu-lus pa-mu-jing-ku sai ja-lo Tu-han.
Di-par-si-ko-la-an, di-la-dang di o-nan nang di la-ut i, di-par-ka-re-jo-an nang di a-wang-a-wang, Kris-tus do-ngan-ki.

rows: Pang-ke ma ting-kim na si-an Tu-han-mu ai tung ha-top la-ho sal-pu do i di-a ma ar ta na hot di-ngo-lu-mu, ho-long-na po-lin na ma-nong-tong i,
Pang-ke ting-kim u-nang ho mar-na-lem-ba to-po-ti u-ru-pi na da-ngol i sai mar-si-non-dang ma baen pa-li-to-mu baen ha-sa-nga-pon di Tu-han-ta i.
